name: all-in-ascent
description: Rock climbing board game with automated agent playtest pipeline + multiplayer online play (PartyKit).

scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run data:check && npm run test:engine && npm run test:party && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:engine: node engine/build-data.js && node engine/build-browser.js && node engine/test-data.js && node engine/test-state.js && node engine/test-helpers.js && node engine/test-engine.js && node engine/test-rules-v07.js && node engine/test-ui-support.js && node engine/test-browser-engine.js
scripts.playtest: npm run test:engine && node sim/run-matrix.js --config=sim/config.json && node analysis/build-report.js --open
scripts.playtest:smoke: npm run test:engine && node sim/run-matrix.js --config=sim/config.smoke.json && node analysis/build-report.js
